analysis.material: Molded plastic jar with printed label
analysis.descriptor: A squat, rounded jar with a slightly waisted body that flares gently toward a base embossed with a faint ornamental pattern. A glossy yellow dome-edged snap cap sits on top, about a quarter of the height. The front label is a white rounded panel framed by an orange arch. At its top is the line SINCE 1925, curved over a circular portrait of a blue-skinned figure with a crown and garland, set on a yellow disc with ornate line art. Below is a red rectangular banner with white block letters KRISHNA, then bold black SPECIAL HING and finer COMPOUNDED ASAFOETIDA. A small green-dot square sits at the banner's right.
